lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: YOU THINK MOPPING FLOORS [beat] IS GOING TO ERASE THE MASSIVE DEBT I OWE FOR TRASHING YOUR VINTAGE SCOOTER, NIX?!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Oh, it is not about the money anymore [beat] because that scooter was actually a rare gift from the principal’s own grandfather!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: I saw everything on the security cameras [beat] and I was ready to expel you until Nix suggested this humble community service instead.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: So I am stuck cleaning gum off the bottom of desks [beat] for the next three months just because you decided to be nice to me?!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Think of it as a long-term investment in your character [beat] because every hall you polish is another step away from being a total jerk.

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: And do not forget to scrub the cafeteria bathrooms [beat] where the math club had a very messy experiment with volcanic soda yesterday.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: This is way worse than just paying for a new ride [beat] my reputation as the toughest kid is literally being washed down the drain.

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: At least now everyone sees the real you, Bruno [beat] the guy who is finally learning that every action has a real consequence in this school.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: And the best part is [beat] that the insurance money for the broken scooter is being donated to the new library fund in your name!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: You are making me look like a local hero [beat] while I am literally wearing a yellow apron and holding a toilet brush in front of everyone?!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: That is the ultimate twist, Bruno [beat] you cannot be a bully when the whole world thinks you are a hard-working saint.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that is how Nix proved [beat] that in this world, kindness is the only currency that actually buys you a completely clean slate.
